response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize this kingdom. Make it...futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
(confused)
Futuristic, sire? But we're in the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
(nodding)
Exactly! That's what I want to change. I want to make this kingdom...vaporwave.

JESTER PIPER
(skeptical)
Vaporwave, sire? But that's a...a...a music genre.

KING REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Details, details. I want to make this kingdom look like it's been transported to a dystopian future. Get the royal architects on it.

CUT TO:

INT. ROYAL ARCHITECTS' OFFICE - DAY

A team of royal architects, led by the ambitious ARCHITECT THOMAS, are brainstorming ideas for the kingdom's new aesthetic.

ARCHITECT THOMAS
(excitedly)
We can use neon lights, sire! And retro-futuristic architecture! And...

KING REGINALD
(interrupting)
Enough. I want it to look like a cross between a futuristic city and a medieval castle. With...with... (he consults a piece of parchment)...with "wet" colors.

ARCHITECT THOMAS
(nodding)
I see what you mean, sire. We can use a lot of pastel colors and...

KING REGINALD
(cutting him off)
And make sure there are a lot of...of... (he searches for the right word)...of "distressed" textures.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now a pastel-colored, neon-lit mess, with distressed textures and weird, futuristic designs. The knights are now wearing neon-colored armor, and the peasants are dressed in futuristic-looking clothing.

KING REGINALD
(satisfied)
Ah, yes. This is more like it.

JESTER PIPER
(approaching the king)
Your Majesty, I think you might want to reconsider this new aesthetic. It's...it's... (he searches for the right word)...it's a bit...out there.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Nonsense, Jester! This is the future of medieval kingdoms!

CUT TO:

INT. ROYAL COURT - DAY

The royal court is now a gathering place for vaporwave enthusiasts. The king is sitting on a throne, surrounded by his courtiers, who are all dressed in futuristic-looking clothing.

KING REGINALD
(to his courtiers)
I want to make this kingdom the center of the vaporwave movement. We'll have vaporwave concerts, vaporwave fashion shows, and...

COURTIER 1
(excitedly)
And we can have vaporwave-themed feasts, sire!

KING REGINALD
(smiling)
Exactly! And we'll serve... (he consults a piece of parchment)...sushi.

COURTIER 2
(confused)
Sushi, sire? But we're in the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Details, details. I want to make this kingdom...futuristic.

FADE OUT.
